author: Derin Savasan
description: Florida Man is a static site that walks through a cleaned set of Florida Man headlines: where they came from, how they were tagged, and how they’re rendered in the browser. Built with D3 + Scrollama.
title: Florida Man

author: Lara Yeyati Preiss
description: This project explores horror as a cultural barometer — capturing, distorting, and projecting our collective fears back to us. Using Netflix's Engagement Report (Jan–Jun 2025), it examines what the platform's most-watched horror titles reveal about contemporary anxieties.
title: Anatomy of a Horror Hit

author: Maggie Navracruz
description: An interactive visualization of media coverage patterns for WNBA players and teams that contrasts statistics and language about the league's physicality with game play videos.
title: WNBA Media Narratives
